name: memo-guard default recall corpus
note: Four projects, deliberately overlapping vocabulary. Query kinds: lexical (shares words with its fact), paraphrase (shares almost none - this is what embeddings are for), gated (the only relevant fact lives in another project, so the correct answer with no --goal is NOTHING), noise (nothing in the store answers it).

facts.text: The PROSPERO registration number for the PMOS review is CRD42024518822
PCOS was renamed to PMOS throughout the manuscript at the editor's request
Enrolment stopped at 389 participants after the recount, not 412
EndNote exported several records with empty journal fields and they had to be filled by hand
Shotgun metagenomics was chosen over 16S because strain-level resolution was needed
Orvosi Hetilap rejected the paper because several references had been fabricated by a language model
Every citation must now be checked against Crossref and PubMed before it goes back in
The rewrite targets an international English-language journal rather than the original Hungarian one
Article-number journals report a DOI fragment where a page range belongs, which produces false positives in the audit
BMC Health Services Research does not accept AI-generated images in any figure
The submission is structured as a Review rather than a Systematic Review
Indirect costs dominate the total burden, mostly through absence from paid work
Vercellini is cited as a secondary source, never as the primary evidence for prevalence
Both embedding models silently truncate long input and report no error
A version field must stay in plugin.json or the cache path becomes unknown and updates fail
The lock lives at a machine-wide path because the resource being guarded is one model server on one machine
Row identifiers are local autoincrement values and are therefore not portable between machines
Deletions leave a tombstone, because union merge alone makes removal impossible
Reweighting is applied to edges and never to facts, to avoid a rich-get-richer loop
Hook latency must stay far below the timeout, so nothing may index synchronously inside a hook
